title: Auxiliary Power Unit Aft Mount Link — Removal
abstract: Removal of the auxiliary power unit aft mount link, including the unit support that must be in place before the last attachment is broken and the recording of the shim stack at the bracket.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove the auxiliary power unit aft mount link, and to record the shim stack at the bracket so that the unit position is restored on installation.
sections.job_setup_note: The auxiliary power unit must be supported on the sling before the aft attachment is broken. The unit will drop by several millimetres at the aft end otherwise, which loads the forward mounts in a direction they are not designed for and can distort the exhaust duct. The shim stack at the bracket sets the unit alignment and must be recorded shim by shim; the stack is not symmetrical and cannot be reconstructed from the total thickness.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm the auxiliary power unit has been shut down for the cooling period given in the figure. 2. Open the tail cone access doors and drop the aft heat shield. WARNING: DO NOT BREAK THE AFT ATTACHMENT BEFORE THE UNIT IS SUPPORTED ON THE SLING. THE UNIT DROPS AT THE AFT END AND LOADS THE FORWARD MOUNTS IN AN UNINTENDED DIRECTION. 3. Fit the support sling to the unit lifting points and take the weight. 4. Release the drain line clamp and lay the line clear. 5. Remove the lockwire from the attachment bolts. 6. Record the shim stack at the bracket, shim by shim, before any shim is removed. CAUTION: RECORD THE SHIM STACK IN ORDER. THE STACK IS NOT SYMMETRICAL AND CANNOT BE REBUILT FROM THE TOTAL THICKNESS ALONE. 7. Remove the aft attachment bolt at the bracket end. 8. Remove the attachment bolt at the unit end. 9. Withdraw the link and put it in the transit container. 10. Bag and label the shims in stack order. 11. Examine the bracket bore and the unit lug bore and record the condition. 12. Fit the protective plugs in both bores.
sections.close_out: Confirm the unit is still supported on the sling and that the sling will remain in place until the link is refitted. Record the shim stack order, the link part number and the two bore conditions. Do not leave the aircraft with the unit unsupported and the link removed.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft carrying the steel link, that is post MOD-149420 or delivered from MSN T00122.

safety_precautions: Support the unit on the sling before the aft attachment is broken.
Confirm the auxiliary power unit cooling period has elapsed.
Support the heat shield before the last fastener is removed.
